text: Web: item dialog swallows save errors — no inline price/currency validation (Android has it)

Closed after 2 review rounds. Parity nuance for follow-up (not blocking): the web parsePriceAmount now strips a currency symbol only at the ends (per this brief + reviewer), which is actually STRICTER than Android parsePriceAmount (strips symbols anywhere). "1€5" is rejected on web, accepted->"15" on Android. If exact parity is wanted, align Android to the web behavior (web is the more-correct one). Realistic-input impact ~nil.
